ops.title: Read permission touches from tool-use projections instead of full turns
ops.description: Owner: /root/ccx_related_topk_ship. Confirmed source: TranscriptSources.touches -> uses -> turns serializes full Turn events and repeated tool bodies. Existing tool_calls projection returns complete errored and pending uses. Next: prepare isolated current-main consumer fix, preserve last-ID-wins/result timestamp ordering and custom/in-memory source behavior; real native query/cost oracle in CI, independent review, merge/release/local guarded install and affected operation verification. No physical IO attribution claimed from source alone.

ops.text: CI proves exact touches parity including errors, pending calls, duplicate IDs, timestamps, window and custom sources; uses no turns projection on native path.
Independent source review and normal CI pass exact merged source, published Capt artifact contains change, local activation verified without interrupting sessions.
Affected operation measurement demonstrates smaller query output and no regression; physical disk/RSS attribution remains explicit.
